integrity: All finite checks are exact using finite-field arithmetic; a proof of geometric completeness and scheme-theoretic reducedness accompanies the checker. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Claims concern the fixed coordinate monomial subgroup and a characteristic-two integral Fermat model. Historical general Hermitian plane counts, code classifications, and global incidence formulas are not claimed as new; equivalent monomial-orbit incidence tables may exist in unindexed literature.
title: Two monomial plane orbits on the characteristic-two Fermat cubic fourfold
